comparison.objective: Insert a USB stick into a computer port; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Connector orientation and low-force keyed insertion versus coaxial mandrel placement, force-regulated striking, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: USB stick plugged in versus four clean fractures, complete containment, and no coil/shell damage. Setup and scoring are missing.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment is generic; connector mating does not test fracture, impact control, or debris recovery.
